heading.title: Of Acceptance and Payment for Honour and Reference in Case of Need

article.title: Payment for honour.
article.content:
113Payment for honour.

Section 113  ·  Chapter XI  ·  page 24 of the Act
When a bill of exchange has been noted or protested for non-payment, any person may pay the same for the honour of any party liable to pay the same: provided that the person so paying 4[or his agent in that behalf] has previously declared before a notary public the party for whose honour he pays, and that such declaration has been recorded by such notary public.
4 Ins. by Act 2 of 1885, s. 9.
